title: Smart City Builder
description: You are the newly appointed City Development Officer of Naya Shahar. Balance infrastructure, environment, economy, and citizen welfare to build a model smart city. Every decision ripples across interconnected systems — choose wisely!
how_to_play: You manage Naya Shahar across 10 months of development.
Each round presents a policy decision with trade-offs across systems.
Watch the dashboard — your subsystems (Transport, Health, Economy, Environment, Education) are interconnected.
Random events like monsoons, elections, and festivals will test your resilience.
NPCs (Mayor, Citizens, Activists) react to your choices in real time.
Aim for balanced growth — maximizing one system at the expense of others will backfire!
learning_objectives: Understand systems thinking and how subsystems interconnect
Practice balancing competing priorities under constraints
Develop strategic thinking about resource allocation
Learn about urban governance, sustainability, and civic responsibility
Build empathy for diverse stakeholder perspectives
cultural_context: Indian urban development, smart city mission, sustainable growth

rounds.situation: Naya Shahar's roads are clogged. Auto-rickshaws, two-wheelers, and private cars create daily gridlock. The Transport Ministry has offered three proposals.
